title: Exact discrepancy and state complexity of linear anti-recurrence sequences
description: For every positive linear form, the exact range of A_n - kappa n (sharp, every value attained; proves Cundric's narrowest-box conjecture) and the exact minimal automaton and state count. Rusty numbers: 10m-4, 10m-1, 10m+1 states for d = 3m, 3m+1, 3m+2, agreeing with Walnut certificates for d <= 15. Also zero coefficients. Answers questions of Fokkink and Joshi (Integers 26 (2026) A24). Preprint, not refereed. Developed with AI assistance (Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's Codex).
